prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1128; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. I felt a hard jolt and my head snapped forward and back. My neck was sore right away, and over the following days it developed into a stiff, aching strain that made turning my head and sleeping difficult. I have described what happened the same way every time I have spoken about it, whether to the other driver, to the responding officer, or to the adjuster on the phone. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this statement to document the collision and the injury I have been treating since.
